title: A Mixed-Methods Study of Personal Software Creation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31217v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: People have long wanted software shaped around their own data, routines, and preferences. We refer to such software as \emph{personal software}. For decades, programming expertise limited who could build it: people without that expertise could build software only within constrained end-user programming tools, such as spreadsheets. AI coding agents seem to remove this bottleneck by letting people build full applications from natural-language descriptions, and many people now build and share personal software publicly. Yet personal software has rarely been studied at scale: we know little about what people build and why, how they build it, and what opportunities and challenges they encounter. We investigate these questions with a mixed-methods study. translated_title: 个人软件创作的混合方法研究
translated_abstract: 长期以来，人们一直希望软件能够围绕自己的数据、日常习惯和偏好来定制，我们将这类软件称为“个人软件”。数十年来，编程专业知识限制了谁能够构建这类软件：缺乏编程专业知识的人只能在受限的终端用户编程工具（如电子表格）中进行开发。AI 编程智能体似乎消除了这一瓶颈，使人们能够通过自然语言描述构建完整的应用程序，如今许多人已公开构建并分享个人软件。然而，个人软件很少得到大规模的研究：对于人们构建什么、为什么构建、如何构建，以及他们遇到的机会与挑战，我们知之甚少。我们通过一项混合方法研究来调查这些问题：一项灰色文献综述分析了 6,168 个网页和 Reddit 帖子，一项观察研究跟踪了八个人使用 AI 编程智能体为自己构建软件并使用长达（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过分析 6,168 条网络与 Reddit 帖子并跟踪八名用户使用 AI 编程智能体构建个人软件的过程，首次大规模揭示了人们创作个人软件的行为、动机及其面临的机遇与挑战。
en_tdlr: This study presents the first large-scale investigation of personal software creation, combining a grey-literature review of 6,168 web and Reddit posts with an observational study of eight users building software with AI coding agents, revealing what people build, why, and the opportunities and challenges involved.
